Mama Maltina
Chocolate Cake
Chocolate cake made with Maltina — Nigeria's beloved malt drink. Deeply moist, deeply nostalgic. A love letter in cake form.
🌍 Heritage
Maltina is the drink of every Nigerian celebration. This cake carries that ritual into the kitchen.
🔬 Science
Malt sugars caramelize at a lower temperature than sucrose — the science behind the crumb's dark, complex sweetness.
